metadata.title: When you get 1 kill and suddenly think you’re carrying the entire VALORANT squad
metadata.description:
Wait, I actually got a kill? My aim was definitely on vacation.
Watch me pretend I planned that shot all along.
Valorant logic doing its usual magic.
Click if you’ve ever lucked your way to glory!

Tap if your best kill was pure luck!
